verdict.rationale: No evidence in the pack mentions any on-chip media engine, hardware AV1/HEVC/ProRes encode-decode block, or integrated graphics video engine for the 9950X3D; the docs only discuss CPU compute acceleration for creative apps (e.g., DaVinci Resolve) via raw processing power, not dedicated hardware codec blocks. This part is a CPU-only die without integrated graphics, so no media-engine capability is documented or implied.
